concept: Amazon MQ: managed JMS/AMQP broker without a rewrite
tests: Choosing a service to migrate a legacy app using standard messaging protocols without code changes.
expected: Amazon MQ (ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ) — supports JMS, AMQP, MQTT, STOMP, OpenWire; lift-and-shift. Triggers: "legacy", "JMS / AMQP", "without rewriting", "managed message broker".
why_not: SQS and EventBridge — proprietary AWS APIs, code changes needed; Kinesis — streaming, not standard broker protocols.
